g.text: (a) Per-class recall of a classifier probe trained on each representation's embedding of the held-out simulated observations (cross-

g.text: validation folds grouped by cell), for SubCellSpace (large dots, filled with the pattern colour) and five other benchmarked

g.text: representations. This analysis uses a 7-class simulated set that includes protrusion in addition to the six training patterns; chance

g.text: is 1/7. SubCellSpace recovers protrusion (0.967) and intranuclear (0.875) patterns reliably, pericellular at 0.728, and perinuclear,

g.text: random, cell-edge and extranuclear patterns at 0.306-0.540. No other representation reaches more than 0.44 on cell-edge or

text.style: font: 7.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: extranuclear. (b) Detection on the Xenium data, over the 250 genes with an APEX-seq ground truth and at least 11 observations (224

text.style: font: 7.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: localized, 26 controls). A gene is called when a Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) test passes after Bonferroni correction over 250 genes and

text.style: font: 7.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: its earth mover's distance (EMD) exceeds 0.06. Left: 112 of 224 localized genes pass the KS gate, so recall cannot exceed 0.50

text.style: font: 7.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: whatever the EMD cut; 69 also pass the EMD cut (recall 0.31). Right: localized genes that pass the KS gate have far more observations

text.style: font: 7.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: available than those that fail it (median 34,975 vs 854; Mann-Whitney p = 2×10⁻¹⁵), so the gate mainly removes low-abundance genes.
